# `aitbc explorer activity-timeline`

Get the daily transaction activity timeline for a period.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc explorer activity-timeline [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--period` | text | `24h` | no | Time period (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Chain ID to query |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc explorer activity-timeline
```
